summary: Enhance your skills with our Financial Intelligence and STRs Training Course. Learn to identify and report suspicious transactions effectively.
lede: Suspicious transaction reporting training helps compliance teams assess unusual activity and document the reasoning behind reporting decisions. It is for compliance professionals, investigators, and risk managers, and covers transaction-pattern and customer-behavior analysis, risk-based case prioritization, and investigation using multiple information sources. It also develops skills in constructing clear narratives and recognizing emerging typologies across digital assets and other payment methods.
audienceIntro: This course serves compliance professionals, investigators, and risk managers who are responsible for detecting, investigating, and reporting suspicious financial activity within regulatory frameworks.
modules: Financial Crime Landscape and Regulatory Framework Fundamentals
Transaction Monitoring and Pattern Recognition Systems
Suspicious Activity Investigation Protocols and Evidence Development
Advanced Money Laundering Typologies and Detection Methods
Digital Assets and Emerging Payment Method Monitoring
Terrorism Financing Detection and National Security Considerations
STR Narrative Construction and Regulatory Documentation Standards
Regulatory Examination Preparation and Response Management
Performance Measurement, Strategic Planning, and Stakeholder Communication
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2 years of experience in compliance, risk management, or financial crimes investigation. Basic knowledge of BSA/AML requirements and familiarity with financial transaction types is essential. Experience with regulatory reporting and customer due diligence processes is recommended.
